title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมพระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 1411

text.en:
Item (b), page eighty-six, group IV, subparagraph twenty-eight, for the City of Manila, paragraph "f," section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, is amended to read as follows:
"(b) Paco Puericulture Center Construction and filling of site ₱20,000.00."

Item B-004.23, page 256-A, title B, appendix A of the same Act, is amended to read as follows:
* * *

Between items B-004.23 and B-004.24, page 256-A, title B, appendix A of the same Act, the following new items are inserted:
"B-004.23 Waiting shed— along Herran St., between Taft Ave. and Pennsylvania GR 8 "B-004.23 Merced Street, City of Manila Asphalting from Herran to Gen. Luna Extension GR 6"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
